title: Parallel Composition of Weighted Finite-State Transducers
relevance: Parallel WFST composition on GPU, showing that transducer composition can be efficiently parallelized—the same algebraic structure underlying chunk-transducer decode.

title: Multi-threaded composition of finite-state automata
venue: FSMNLP (Finite State Methods and Natural Language Processing)
relevance: Multi-threaded FSA composition showing practical speedup bounds and implementation strategies for parallel composition.

title: Data-Parallel Finite-State Machines
relevance: The enumerated-state approach implicitly uses the monoid structure of transition function composition.

title: JParEnt: Parallel entropy decoding for JPEG decompression on heterogeneous multicore architectures
relevance: Parallel entropy decoding for JPEG using chunk-based approach on heterogeneous architectures, analogous pattern to transducer-chunk decode.
